data.narrative:
Firehawk Aerospace is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Will Edwards that has raised $25M+. Valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, and Anduril Industries, all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $25M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $50M. Peer-median analysis draws on four same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The median across this quartet is $700M, reflecting wide dispersion in the peer set.

The triangulated valuation range is $42M (floor) to $805M (ceiling), with a median of $375M across both methods. The wide spread—spanning nearly two orders of magnitude—reflects material uncertainty around the appropriate peer set weighting. Key dependencies include whether Firehawk's technology, market position, and capital efficiency align more closely with early-stage capital-efficient entrants (lower quartile) or with better-capitalized, more mature defense primes (upper quartile). Reconciliation of this range would benefit from deeper analysis of unit economics, customer concentration, and technical differentiation relative to nearest-neighbor peers.
